title: 44.6% of Woburn Public Schools District students meet or exceed science MCAS expectations in 2022-23 school year
text:
Of the 917 students who took part in the MCAS, 36.3% met the testing standard while 8.3% exceeded expectations, according to the Massachusetts Department of Elementary and Secondary Education.
The number of Woburn Public Schools District students who met or exceeded expectations fell by 9.3% from the previous school year.
Woburn Public Schools District roughly covers schools within Middlesex County and has a main office in Woburn.
In the 2022-23 school year, 200,905 students took the science test in Massachusetts with 86,558 students passing, 1.5% less than the year before.
According to a 2025 analysis from WalletHub, Massachusetts education system was considered the best in the nation, based on factors such as class size, student performance, funding, school safety, and teacher qualifications.
